initialization: Each gamma row starts from the declared initial_state; increasing-alpha continuation within that row uses the previous cell's final state. Rows are independent.

transect.initialization: Common fixed initial_state for every point; independent of grid continuation.

selection.core: Nearest period-9 candidate to source-figure visual estimate (1.064,10.26), using coordinates scaled by focus-rectangle widths. If absent record missing, never substitute another period.
selection.outer: Farthest period-9 candidate from core within its 8-connected period-9 component in the focus grid; classify as outer component point, not assumed limb/boundary.
selection.doubled: Nearest period-18 candidate to core if any; else missing.
selection.exterior: Nearest no-short-period focus cell to core with finite-time exponent greater than 0.005; else nearest no-short-period cell, explicitly without positive-exponent label.

refinement.initialization: Each selected grid cell's retained final state; assesses its captured regime, not basin independence.

orbit_certificate: Independent DOP853 shooting, complete-state closure with phase condition, primitive x3-peak count, full variational monodromy; retain the neutral flow multiplier and check transverse multipliers. Failed certificates remain failures.

behavior.initialization: Each selected cell's finest-refinement terminal state; paired perturbations share it.

claim_boundary: Numerical reproduction of shrimp-shaped periodic windows in this fixed-weight three-neuron recurrent network and measured correspondence to its state/activation behavior. No gradient-training, task-correctness, learned-reasoning, novelty, or optimization benefit claim.
figures: complete overview/focus peak-period maps with all unresolved cells retained
common-initialization transect: x3 maxima, periods, exponent and activation variability
selected full-state and activation trajectories with perturbation separation
full-state closure, transverse Floquet multipliers and step-refinement table
differences_from_source: Lower resolution and shorter transient than the published 1000-square grid with dt=0.01 and 10000 transient time
Initial state and row-reset convention explicit here but unspecified in paper
Full-state peak-event recurrence supplements source scalar-peak detector
Focused ROI inferred visually before outcomes; overview rectangle exactly matches source Figure 2.3b
Source printed oblique-transect formula appears inconsistent with its figure; not used
failure_rules: No adaptive rerun or replacement of consumed attempt
Retain incomplete rows, failed cells, missing selections and failed certificates
Ceiling terminates this attempt; continuation requires dated amendment preserving completed evidence
Reject model, source or manifest drift before execution
